recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male portrait in an urban street setting, topped by a high-contrast, textured horizontal header containing large-scale serif typography and smaller secondary text blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured header vs. smooth photographic lower section
Lime green typography against dark brown/gold marble texture
Subject's red patterned jacket as the primary color pop against neutral city tones
Vertical alignment of the 'I' in the main title with the subject's central axis
coreInvariants: Horizontal split at the top 20% mark
Distressed or marbled texture in the top band
Out-of-focus urban background with warm brick tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered subject from waist up, occupying the bottom 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large lime green 'I' and 'N' in the top left-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright green text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the red jacket patterns to the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured header provides breathing room for the title; the street background provides depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and brick reds in the urban background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the leather jacket and shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime green for primary text; bright red for jacket patterns.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text and jacket patterns against a desaturated, hazy background.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin
Tight kerning for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended vertical stem on the initial 'I' to overlap the image boundary

composition.position: Flanking the main title on dark blue bars

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a minimalist sans-serif for secondary details.
graphicDevices: Horizontal dark blue rectangular bars behind secondary text
Marbled/spattered texture overlay in the header

avoid: Centered text in the lower image area

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, sharp serif aesthetic of the main title.
Appropriate for the small, wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man in a black leather jacket with red geometric patterns, standing in a soft-focus urban street with brick buildings. Leave the top 20% of the frame as a dark brown and gold marbled texture band.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large uppercase serif name in lime green across the textured band. Add two small dark blue horizontal bars on either side of the name containing lowercase sans-serif text in red.

verificationChecks: Is the top band clearly textured and distinct from the photo?
Does the first letter of the name slightly overlap the photo edge?
Is the lime green text highly legible against the dark texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clean separation between header and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the serif font has sharp, elegant terminals.
Verify the horizontal split is straight and clean.
Check that the red in the jacket is vibrant.
Confirm the secondary text bars are perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Textured Header Band + High-Contrast Serif + Geometric Accent Colors
